title: Pure Nemleria
summary: Pure Nemleria build with generic Rank 10 Xyz Monsters and staples. Nemleria treats its Extra Deck as a countdown clock: its Level 10 Beasts and Continuous Spells banish Extra Deck cards face-down as cost until only Dreaming Nemleria remains, waking her up to banish the opponent's field and GY.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sweet Dreams, Nemleria searches any Nemleria monster from the Deck, and if Dreaming Nemleria is face-up in your Extra Deck, the opponent cannot activate cards or effects when a Nemleria monster is Normal or Special Summoned that turn.
Dreaming Nemleria in the Pendulum Zone places a Nemleria Continuous Spell (Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria) from your Deck or GY face-up on your field and sends itself face-up to the Extra Deck.
Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria banishes 2 face-down cards from your Extra Deck to add 2 Level 10 Beast monsters with different names from your Deck to your hand.

summary.title: Opening: Dreaming Nemleria
steps: Place Dreaming Nemleria in the Pendulum Zone and use its effect to place Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria from the Deck while putting Dreaming Nemleria face-up into the Extra Deck.
Activate Dream Tower of Princess Nemleria by banishing 2 face-down Extra Deck cards to search Nemleria Dream Defender - Couette and Nemleria Dream Devourer - Reveil (or Oreiller).

Special Summon Couette and Oreiller from the hand (free while you have a face-up Pendulum in the Extra Deck), banish 3 face-down Extra Deck cards to summon Reveil, and use Reveil to tribute a Level 10 Beast and Set Nemleria Louve or Nemleria Repeter directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Waking Dreaming Nemleria
summary.text: Dreaming Nemleria cannot be Normal Summoned or Set, and can only be Special Summoned from face-up in the Extra Deck once you have no other cards in your Extra Deck (besides Dreaming Nemleria herself). Because using Dreaming Nemleria's Pendulum Effect locks you out of Special Summoning Dreaming Nemleria that same turn, you whittle down the Extra Deck across Turn 1 and the opponent's turn with Dream Tower, Reveil, and Repeter, then summon Dreaming Nemleria on Turn 3 to banish 1 card from the opponent's field and/or GY face-down for every 3 of your face-down banished cards, shuffling that many banished cards back into the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff: Level 10 Beasts & Rank 10s
points: Nemleria Dream Defender - Couette banishes 1 face-down Extra Deck card as a Quick Effect to negate any opponent's effect that targets your Nemleria card(s) while Dreaming Nemleria is in the Extra Deck.
Nemleria Dream Devourer - Reveil summons itself from the hand or GY by banishing 3 non-Pendulum Extra Deck cards face-down and Sets a Nemleria Trap from the Deck.

Dreaming Reality of Nemleria, Realized summons itself from the hand by returning a monster you control to the Deck, then either places Dreaming Nemleria from the Deck into the Extra Deck or flips another face-up monster face-down.

While using Dream Tower locks you to Pendulums from the Extra Deck for that turn, on turns you don't use Dream Tower two Level 10 Beasts can overlay into Number 35: Ravenous Tarantula, Skypalace Gangaridai, or Mercurium the Living Quicksilver.

summary.title: Traps
points: Nemleria Repeter banishes face-down Extra Deck cards to resolve one of three effects: banish 1 card to recover a Nemleria from the GY, banish 2 to halve all damage you take that turn, or banish 3 and send a Level 10 Beast to the GY to negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls.

Nemleria Louve Special Summons a Nemleria monster or Level 10 Beast from your hand or Deck (returning it to the hand during the End Phase) and banishes itself from the GY to reduce an opposing monster's ATK and DEF.
